overview: A complete single-page responsive website for Prakash Electronics, a trusted local electronics store in Bengaluru, India. Features a premium design with navy blue and electric orange branding, full product category showcase, brand carousel, contact section with embedded Google Maps, and mobile-optimized floating contact bar.
features: Sticky navigation with clickable phone number
Hero section with Call Us Now and Get Directions CTAs
Product categories grid with hover animations (8 categories)
Brand logo carousel with greyscale-to-color hover (12 brands)
Trust badges section with store credentials
Contact section with embedded Google Maps and WhatsApp button
Fully responsive design optimized for all screen sizes
